summaries.ko: SK그룹 최태원 회장이 노소영 관장에게 9천440억원을 지급하라는 파기환송심 판결에 불복해 대법원에 재상고했으며, 이는 재산분할 비율 및 규모 산정의 법리 오해를 주장하고 시간을 벌어 지연이자를 피하려는 의도로 분석된다.
summaries.en: SK Group Chairman Choi Tae-won has filed a re-appeal to the Supreme Court against the High Court's ruling to pay Noh So-young 944 billion KRW in their divorce asset division, claiming legal misinterpretation in the calculation and with some analysts suggesting the move is to buy time and avoid late payment interest.
summaries.zh: SK集团会长崔泰源不服法院要求其向卢素英支付9440亿韩元的资产分割裁决，已向大法院提起再上诉，此举被分析为是为了主张财产分割比例和金额计算存在法律误解，并争取时间以避免支付滞纳金。

summaries.en: National Power Party Secretary-General Jeong Hui-yong publicly expressed his displeasure regarding Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon's attendance at the party's floor countermeasures meeting, stating that it was "unprecedented for a local government head to participate."
summaries.zh: 国民力量党秘书长郑熙溶公开表达了对首尔市长吴世勋出席党内院内对策会议的不满，称“地方政府首长参与此类会议史无前例”。
